self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: R5 Chord: Gaining 5 Harmonics (from Normal/Charged Attack hits) triggers a burst dealing 200% ATK DMG to surrounding opponents. Modeled as a supplementary hit — its own rotation target (weapon/extraHit), weight = how many Chord bursts the rotation triggers; physical, scales with ATK and CRIT only, no DMG% bonuses.
